name: Tonic | 10mg Beverage | Fizz Black Cherry 1:1
description:
THC Infused Beverage
10mg THC : 10mg CBD

Refresh and unwind with Tonic Fizz 1:1 Black Cherry. This sparkling cannabis-infused beverage combines the rich and tangy flavor of black cherries with a perfectly balanced 1:1 ratio of CBD to THC. Infused with 5mg CBD and 5mg THC per bottle, it delivers calming and uplifting effects, perfect for relaxation, easing stress, or enhancing social moments. Tonic Fizz Black Cherry is the ideal drink for a flavorful and harmonious cannabis experience.
